diagram_math_checks.data: Real quadratic space (V,B), Q(u) nonzero; a=B(v,u)/Q(u), w=v-au.
diagram_math_checks.check: B(w,u)=B(v,u)-a Q(u)=0, so w lies in u-perp. The direct sum V=Ru plus u-perp is proved in lem-real-orthogonal-space-preliminaries step 1.1. The picture depicts the independent u,w case in their two-dimensional span; the horizontal line is explicitly Rw contained in u-perp, not the entire hyperplane in general dimension.

diagram_math_checks.data: Map rho_u=r_u: V to V, with r_u(v)=v-2B(v,u)u/Q(u).
diagram_math_checks.check: Assigned item step 1.1 proves rho_u(v)=-uvu/Q(u)=r_u(v). Substitution v=au+w yields -au+w. Thus arrows from origin to (2.2,1.3) and (2.2,-1.3) share the same horizontal w-component and have opposite vertical au-components. Dashed segments mark component projections; they carry no extra maps.

diagram_math_checks.data: Invariant bilinear form and reflection directions.
diagram_math_checks.check: For v=au+w and z=bu+t, w,t in u-perp, B(v,z)=ab Q(u)+B(w,t)=B(-au+w,-bu+t). Hence the indicated sign reversal preserves B, fixes u-perp pointwise, and sends u to -u, as supplier step 3.1 proves. No drawn angle, length, or positive norm is asserted, so indefinite signatures and isotropic w are permitted.
